requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67723] POS Interface - General V3 - Add payment details in /vouchers/redeem/prepare (Iris Chan)
Descriptions:
It is available for General V3 membership interface
System supports adding unsaved payment details into transaction payload on external API request “Prepare Redeem Voucher” by new interface payment setting “Add Unsaved Payments Into Transaction Payload For Prepare Redeem Voucher” with default value as “Yes”
Workflow
1. Open a printed check with General V3 member attached
2. Click function “Paid” to go to cashier
3. Select target payment method attached with General V3 membership interface
4. If interface setting “Payment Type” of target payment method does not exist or value is not set as “By input voucher number” or “By input voucher number and member number”, system follows existing workflow for continue operation. Workflow stops here
5. If interface setting “Payment Type” of target payment method exists with value as “By input voucher number” or “By input voucher number and member number”, system triggers external API request “Prepare Redeem Voucher”
6. If new interface setting “Add Unsaved Payments Into Transaction Payload For Prepare Redeem Voucher” of target payment method does not exist or value as “No”, system follows existing workflow to prepare the transaction payload for external API request “Prepare Redeem Voucher”
7. If new interface setting “Add Unsaved Payments Into Transaction Payload For Prepare Redeem Voucher” of target payment method exist with value as “Yes”, system adds the payment details of the selected payment method in step 3 into the transaction payload for external API request “Prepare Redeem Voucher”
8. System continues operation
Setup:
Setup for adding unsaved payment details into transaction payload on prepare redeem voucher
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Interface Configurations à Payment Settings
Click “Add New” to configure a new setup
Select
Apply To
All Locations – For all locations
Shop – For a specific shop
Outlet – For a specific outlet
Station – For a specific station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Interface = Target General V3 membership interface
Payment Type = By input voucher number / By input voucher number and member number
Add Unsaved Payments Into Transaction Payload For Prepare Redeem Voucher = Yes
Click “Save” to save the record

requirement.summary: POS - LPS Debit Card - Mask balances and show "Card is not valid" for invalid cards
requirement.description:
User Story

As a POS user performing an LPS Debit Card enquiry, I want the enquiry result screen to show a standardized "Card is not valid" message and mask balances for invalid cards, so that I am not misled into thinking an invalid card has a usable balance.

Current Behavior

The LPS Debit Card enquiry result screen displays the exact status string returned from the middleware verbatim (e.g., "Freeze", blank). For most non-Normal statuses the card is actually invalid, yet the screen still shows the balance as 0.00, which misleads users into thinking the card has a usable balance.

Expected Behavior

The LPS Debit Card enquiry result screen presents a standardized status display. When the card is valid (status "Normal"), the current display is unchanged. When the card is invalid (status "PendingSales", "isExpired" true, or any other non-Normal status), the screen shows a clear "Card is not valid" message and masks Card Balance, Gift Balance, and Total Balance as ***. When isExpired=true co-occurs with a non-Normal status string, the "Expired (Card is not valid)" message always takes precedence. This is a display-only change: the user can still proceed with any action as before, and all users see the masked balances with no override. Only the LPS Debit Card enquiry result screen is in scope. The Expiry Date is not shown on the enquiry result screen; it appears only in the interface log.

Masking is controlled by a new setup option under Interface Control > LPS Debit Card loyalty interface > General Setup:

- Setup name: Mask Check Value Result Balance

- Dropdown options: No (Default), Yes

- When "Yes", invalid cards show *** balances; when "No" (default), invalid cards show raw balances.

- This option is not available for card status "Normal" (Normal always shows raw balances unchanged).

Acceptance Criteria

Normal status unchanged

- Given the LPS Debit Card enquiry returns status 'Normal'

- When the enquiry result screen is displayed

- Then the current enquiry result display is shown with no modification

Expired card

- Given the LPS Debit Card enquiry returns 'isExpired' as true and the 'Mask Check Value Result Balance' option is 'Yes'

- When the enquiry result screen is displayed

- Then the status shows 'Expired (Card is not valid)' in English or 'Expired (此卡已失效)' in Chinese

- And Card Balance, Gift Balance, and Total Balance display as ***

- But if the returned status is also non-Normal (e.g., 'PendingSales'), the 'Expired (Card is not valid)' message still takes precedence

PendingSales status

- Given the LPS Debit Card enquiry returns status 'PendingSales', 'isExpired' is not true, and the 'Mask Check Value Result Balance' option is 'Yes'

- When the enquiry result screen is displayed

- Then the status shows 'PendingSales (Card is not valid)' in English or 'PendingSales (此卡已失效)' in Chinese

- And Card Balance, Gift Balance, and Total Balance display as ***

Other non-Normal status

- Given the LPS Debit Card enquiry returns a status that is not 'Normal' or 'PendingSales', 'isExpired' is not true, and the 'Mask Check Value Result Balance' option is 'Yes'

- When the enquiry result screen is displayed

- Then the status shows '
{Returned status from interface} (Card is not valid)' in English or '{Returned status from interface}

(此卡已失效)' in Chinese

- And Card Balance, Gift Balance, and Total Balance display as ***

- But if the returned status is blank or empty, the status shows only '(Card is not valid)' in English or '(此卡已失效)' in Chinese with no status name prefix

Masking option set to No

- Given the LPS Debit Card enquiry returns an invalid status (non-Normal) and the 'Mask Check Value Result Balance' option is 'No'

- When the enquiry result screen is displayed

- Then the status message is shown as described for the invalid status

- But Card Balance, Gift Balance, and Total Balance display raw values instead of ***

Supporting Evidence

Reference attachments: Workflow 67356.png. The ticket references example screenshots and interface logs for each status case: "Status - Normal - no change required.png" (Case 1), "Status - PendingSales - change required.png" (Case 2), "IsExpired is true - change required.png" (Case 3), "Other status and not expired - change required.png" (Case 4), plus "Status is Freeze - Invalid.png" and "No status - Invalid.png" (blank/other status examples).

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: not specified

Target Version: not specified

Notes: no deadline provided by requester

Alternatives Considered

Considered showing the raw status string only versus a standardized "Card is not valid" message; the standardized message was chosen to avoid misleading users. Also considered an override to reveal unmasked balances for troubleshooting, but rejected per requirement that all users see masked balances.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Vendor Key

lps_debit_card

User Story

Currently, the enquiry result screen will display the exact status returned from Middleware but for users, most of the status represent the card is inactive and currently though the card is invalid, it is showing the balance as 0.00 which is misleading

Attached the example of current enquiry result screen -

Attached Status is Freeze - Invalid.png and No status - Invalid.png

Requirement

It is required to have a standard screen to show the status from the enquiry result

Below listed all the cases:

Case 1: the status returned is 'Normal' (no modification required)

Attached Status - Normal - no change required.png display the current enquiry result

Attached also the interface log for this situation - Log for card 6363402333320413207 - normal (no change required).txt

Case 2: the status returned is 'PendingSales'

Status display as "PendingSales (Card is not valid)" [English], "PendingSales (此卡已失效)" [中文]

- Card Balance, Gift Balance, Total Balance should display as ***

Attached Status - PendingSales - change required.png display the current enquiry result

Attached also the interface log for this situation - Log for card 6363402333310443221 - pendingsales (change required).txt

Case 3: 'isExpired' return 'true

- The status should display 'Expired (Card is not valid)' (English) or 'Expired (此卡已失效)' (中文)

- Card Balance, Gift Balance, Total Balance should display as ***

- Should display the Expiry Date based on the response

Attached IsExpired is true - change required.png is the sample of the required change

Attached also the interface log for this situation - Log for card 6363401529210066547 - expired (change required).txt

Case 4: The status returned is not 'Normal' or 'PendingSales' and the 'IsEquired' is not true

- The status should display '{Returned status from interface} (Card is not valid)' (English) or '{Returned status from interface} (此卡已失效)' (Chinese)

- Card Balance, Gift Balance, Total Balance should display as ***

Attached Other status and not expired - change required.png is the sample of the required change

Attached also the interface log for this situation - Log for card 6363405895560084436 - other or no status (change required).txt
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67356] POS - LPS Debit Card - Mask balances and show "Card is not valid" for invalid cards (Teresa)
Descriptions:
It is available for LPS Debit Card loyalty interface
System displays the status message and masking balance values on corresponding card status on the enquiry result display screen
Workflow
1. Open check
2. Click function “Loyalty SVC Check Value” or “Loyalty SVC Check Value (Key-in)”
3. Swipe card or manual input card number
4. System follows existing workflow to trigger external party API for enquiry card details
5. If value of status from external party returned is “Normal” and “PendingSales”, system follows existing behaviour for displaying “Normal” and “PendingSales” on status and go to step 7
6. If value of status from external party returned is not “Normal” and “PendingSales”, system displays value of status with specific status message
Format in English: <Value of status from external party> (Card is not valid)

requirement.description:
20260720 Update:

[payment_details] => array(

[code] => "0002",

[amount] => 20.00,

[type] => "credit_card"

),

),

20260713 Update:

It is request to store all payment info into HQ in oder for future requirements from other customer.

Request body:

- Check Total (existing)

- Payment Total

- Payment code

- Payment amount

- Payment Tips amount

User Story:

As a CRM system operator at Swire Hotels (China properties), I want the POS to include payment total and room charge amount in the check-completion message sent to TMS, so that the CRM can pull complete reservation payment data without manual reconciliation.

Current Behavior:

After a reservation is completed at the POS, the POS sends a check-completion message to TMS containing only the check total, check number. Payment breakdown details — including total payment across all tender types and the amount settled specifically via room charge — are not transmitted, requiring CRM operators to manually reconcile payment data. Currently, release payment, void check, adjust payment after completion will update the check total through thank you message. Void payment will not update the check total.

Expected Behavior:

After a reservation is completed at the POS, the POS sends a check-completion message to TMS containing the following fields:

- Check total (existing)

- Check number (existing)

- Payment total — the sum of all tender types applied to the check (new)

- Room charge amount — the total amount settled via the room charge payment method at checkout (new)

The extended message must be backward-compatible with TMS instances that do not yet consume the new fields.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Payment total includes all tender types

- Room charge amount reflects only room charge payment

- Existing fields remain unchange

- Returns zero value when no payment is applied

- Returns zero room charge value when room charge payment is not used

- Backward compatibility — TMS should ignores unknown fields without error for verison before this case released

- Release payment, void check, adjust payment after completion will update the check total

- Void payment will not update the check total

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Authority Ask Password field not masked
requirement.description:
Use Case:

TMS 2.0 Function Authority dialog (title: Authority : Ask Password). User must enter a password to proceed. Password must stay masked while typing.

Steps to Reproduce:

- Log in to TMS 2.0.

- Run a function whose outlet function authority is Ask Password (e.g. confirm / void / similar).

- Dialog opens. Focus the Password field and type.

Current Result:

Password is shown as plaintext (e.g. 51 visible). Input stays type=text after the first keystroke. [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

Password is masked (dots/asterisks) for the whole input. [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

react/Tms/operation/src/components/Authority/AuthorityDialog.jsx used an autofill workaround from r17917 (leto_li, JIRA #11401): render type=text then set event.target.type = password in onFocus.

That survived on React 16/18 because React skipped rewriting type when the prop was still text. After HERO-65836 (React 19.2.5), updateInput() writes node.type from props on every commit, so the first setState on typing forces the field back to text.

HKJC AuthorityDialog already uses type=password. Login (UserLogin.tsx) uses React-controlled type and is not affected. This is the only TMS 2.0 hit of the DOM type mutation.

Fix:

Set type=password in JSX. Remove handleFocus. Keep autocomplete=new-password for Chrome autofill.
